title: Handley Page Halifax JB798
memorial_details: description: ON 10TH MAY 1944 IN THE EARLY MORNING AN R.A.F. AEROPLANE/ STRUCK THE SPIRE OF THIS CHURCH AND FELL ON BUILDINGS NEARBY./ THE SPIRE WAS DEMOLISHED AND OTHER EXTENSIVE DAMAGE WAS DONE/ TO THE CHURCH AND ADJOINING BUILDINGS. THE NAMES OF THOSE/ WHO THEN LOST THEIR LIVES ARE INSCRIBED BELOW. RESTORATION/ OF THE BUILDING WAS BEGUN ON 10TH MAY. 1949 AND THE CHURCH/ WAS RE-DEDICATED ON 11TH DECEMBER .1950/ CIVILIAN PARISHIONERS/ (NAMES)/ AEROPLANE CREW/ R.A.A.F/ (NAMES)
